project_type: Next.js 16 app with React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript, App Router
build_system: bun (npm-compatible) with Next.js CLI. No npm/node installed - use bunx for next commands.
test_framework: No test framework configured yet. ESLint for linting.
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'bunx eslint .' to check lint. 2. Run 'bunx next build' to verify build succeeds. Both must pass with zero errors.
environment_constraints: No npm/node binary available - use bun/bunx instead. OPEN_INTERNET network mode allows package installs. AGENTS.md warns about Next.js breaking changes but node_modules/next/dist/docs/ does not exist. Build uses bunx next build.
contribution_requirements: Zero lint errors, zero build errors, responsive Tailwind CSS, semantic HTML, accessibility (ARIA labels), no console.log in production, loading/empty/error states for features.
key_patterns: Components are 'use client' in app/components/. Types live in lib/types.ts. API route in app/api/riot/route.ts. Data fetched client-side via fetch in Dashboard.tsx. Tailwind 4 with @import 'tailwindcss' and @custom-variant. Dark mode via .dark class on html element. Image optimization via next/image with ddragon.leagueoflegends.com allowlisted.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js app router pages and components. app/components/ - all client components. app/api/riot/ - API route for Riot Games. lib/ - utility functions and types. public/ - static assets.
